name: Seunghun Yang
headline: Embedded AI · Computer Vision · Game Development
position: Professor, Advanced Industry Talent Bootcamp, Halla University
summary: I started in graduate research on detecting roads, vehicles and pedestrians in front-facing car cameras, then worked as a road image-processing engineer.
I co-founded the indie studio Hoit Studio, where as CTO I built 12 mobile games, and later worked at PlayHard as a Growth Programmer on game development, data-driven monetization and live updates.
Today I teach embedded AI and image processing at a university, and focus on explaining AI that runs on small boards so that complete beginners can follow along.

operations.title: Data & performance analysis
operations.desc: Analyzed player behavior and ad campaign performance with Firebase and Google Analytics, and fed the results into update and monetization decisions.

operations.title: User acquisition & ad creatives
operations.desc: Ran user acquisition campaigns on Google Ads, Facebook Ads and Unity Ads, analyzed performance by creative, and produced the ad creatives myself.
